title: Indefinite Stochastic LQ Optimal Control for Jump-Diffusion Systems with Random Coefficients
summary: This paper studies indefinite stochastic linear-quadratic (LQ) optimal control for jump-diffusion systems with random coefficients. We construct an algebraic inverse flow from the zero-control base system, extract the semimartingale kernel of the value function, and prove that it satisfies a generalized stochastic Riccati equation with jumps (SREJ).
